brief: A bike rack that clamps to the roof of my car.

requirements.evidence: Car roof clamp unsafe in printed plastic.

events.text:
<atem:function_calls>
<atem:invoke name="default.finish">
<atem:parameter name="outcome">declined</atem:parameter>
<atem:parameter name="requirements">[{"evidence": "No parts placed. 3D-printed plastic parts with fit-only checking cannot be verified for clamping force, vibration, wind load at driving speed, or road safety. A failure would drop a bike onto the road and endanger people.", "requirement": "Rack that holds a bike", "status": "unmet"}, {"evidence": "No parts placed. A clamp to a car roof is a safety-critical automotive restraint where failure at speed risks serious harm to occupants and others; not buildable in Hex Cluster plastic.", "requirement": "Clamps to the roof of a car for road use", "status": "unmet"}]</atem:parameter>
<atem:parameter name="summary">Declined - cannot safely build a car-roof bike rack from 3D-printed Hex Cluster parts. Fit-only checking says nothing about strength, vibration, wind load, or safe clamping to a car, and failure at speed would endanger people. I placed nothing. I could instead build a stationary floor/wall bike stand for garage storage - no car clamping or road use.</atem:parameter>
</atem:invoke>
